value.title: Extract shared deterministic materializeContracts helper
value.description: Pull the contract-creation loop at src/orchestrator/pipeline.ts:861-906 into a reusable materializeContracts(spec, projectRoot, config) helper that runTsPipeline calls in place of the inline loop. Feature-derived contract content is preserved; contract ids become deterministic and zero-padded as sprint-<specId>-NN so listContracts lexical ordering matches execution order. The post-plan and post-sprint-contract audit checkpoints stay in the pipeline.

successCriteria.description: Running npm run build and the TypeScript typecheck completes with zero errors after the helper extraction.
A unit test confirms runTsPipeline delegates contract creation to materializeContracts while the post-plan and post-sprint-contract audit checkpoints remain in the pipeline body.

With generateContractPrecision mocked, a three-feature spec that has no embedded sprints produces feature-derived contracts whose title, description, successCriteria, status, precision fields, sprintNumber and features match the pre-refactor output.
Materialized contract ids follow the deterministic sprint-<specId>-NN form, zero-padded so that listContracts lexical ordering matches sprint execution order for a spec with twelve or more sprints.
The full existing vitest suite passes with no regressions in run.test.ts after the refactor.

nonGoals: Do not change the pipeline phase order, audit checkpoint sites, or the research and plan steps.
Do not introduce the embedded spec.sprints branch in this sprint; that arrives in Sprint 2.
stopConditions: Stop when materializeContracts is the single source of feature-derived contract creation called by runTsPipeline and the suite is green.
Stop when contract ids are deterministic and zero-padded and ordering is verified for twelve-plus sprints.
value.definitionOfDone: The contract-creation loop is extracted into a reusable materializeContracts helper that runTsPipeline calls; feature-derived contract content is preserved, contract ids are deterministic and zero-padded for stable ordering, and the full test suite passes.
assumptions: generateContractPrecision remains an async planner LLM call and is mocked in tests.
The post-plan and post-sprint-contract checkpoints are pipeline concerns and stay outside the helper.
value.generatorNotes: Keep the feature-derived branch faithful to pipeline.ts:861-906: same createContract inputs (criteria mapped with verificationMethod agent-evaluation), same logging strings, same order. Replace only the id assignment with deterministic zero-padded sprint-<specId>-NN. Helper signature: materializeContracts(spec, projectRoot, config). Have it return the SprintContract[] so the pipeline can pass it to the post-sprint-contract checkpoint. Honor the freeze comment intent (pipeline.ts:610-612) for everything except the now-authorized id scheme and the later embedded-sprints support.
value.evaluatorNotes: Verify the inline loop is gone from runTsPipeline and replaced by a single helper call. Confirm checkpoints at the post-plan and post-sprint-contract sites still fire with the same arguments. Add or extend a test that builds a 12-sprint spec and asserts listContracts returns contracts in sprintNumber order. Confirm feature-derived content parity by snapshotting contract fields other than id/timestamps.

value.title: Embedded-sprint materialization and eager wiring into plan
value.description: Extend materializeContracts to prefer valid embedded spec.sprints: safeParse each entry against SprintContractSchema, normalize status to proposed, and on any parse or precision failure fall back to feature-derived generation without throwing. Wire runPlanCommand to call materializeContracts after a successful non-clarification plan, clearing the current specId's prior contracts first, and correct the next-step hint so it points to a command that now functions.

successCriteria.description: Running npm run build and the typecheck completes with zero errors after wiring eager materialization into the plan command.

Given a spec whose sprints array entries each satisfy SprintContractSchema, materializeContracts writes one contract file per entry with status normalized to proposed and the embedded success criteria and precision fields preserved.

Given a spec whose sprints entries omit status or use an unknown verificationMethod, materializeContracts does not throw and instead writes feature-derived contracts that satisfy SprintContractSchema.
After runPlanCommand completes for a ready spec the contracts directory contains schema-valid files, while a spec with status needs-clarification yields zero contract files.
Re-running materialization for the same specId overwrites that specId's prior contracts and leaves no stale higher-numbered files behind.
The plan command prints a next-step hint that points to a command which succeeds, consistent with the hint printed by plan answer.

nonGoals: Do not add a separate contracts CLI command.
Do not modify the sprint command's contract selection in this sprint; that is Sprint 3.
stopConditions: Stop when plan writes valid contracts from embedded sprints with feature-derived fallback and the needs-clarification path writes none.
Stop when re-planning the same spec does not accumulate stale contract files.
value.definitionOfDone: The plan command eagerly materializes schema-valid sprint contracts from embedded spec.sprints when present, falls back to feature-derived generation otherwise, skips materialization for needs-clarification specs, avoids stale-file accumulation, and prints an accurate next-step hint.
assumptions: Embedded entries that fail safeParse trigger a whole-set feature-derived fallback rather than a partial mix, keeping a single id scheme per spec.
Clearing prior contracts is scoped to files whose specId matches the current spec, leaving other specs untouched.
outOfScope: Honoring embedded sprints inside run is already delivered via the shared helper from Sprint 1 and needs no extra plan-side work.
value.generatorNotes: Add the embedded branch to materializeContracts from Sprint 1: iterate spec.sprints, SprintContractSchema.safeParse each, override id with deterministic sprint-<specId>-NN, force status to proposed, and pass through saveContract (which still enforces the precision gate). If any entry fails to parse, log and fall back to the feature-derived branch for the whole spec. In runPlanCommand (plan.ts), after printPlan and only when result.kind is not needs-clarification, call materializeContracts(spec, projectRoot, config). Before writing, delete existing .bober/contracts files whose parsed specId equals spec.specId. Update printPlan's final hint; reconcile the inconsistency where plan suggests sprint (plan.ts:171) but plan answer suggests run (plan.ts:290).
value.evaluatorNotes: Test three paths: valid embedded sprints used verbatim with normalized status; malformed embedded sprints falling back to feature-derived without throwing; needs-clarification spec producing zero contracts. Verify idempotency by materializing a 3-sprint spec, then a 2-sprint version of the same specId, and asserting only two files remain. Confirm the printed hint names a command that the new code makes functional.

value.title: Scope sprint to the active spec with clarification guard
value.description: Make runSprintCommand select only the contracts whose specId matches the latest loaded spec, refuse to run when the latest spec has status needs-clarification, and improve the empty-contracts message to point at re-planning or the full pipeline. The single-spec flow stays unchanged.

successCriteria.description: Running npm run build and the typecheck completes with zero errors after the sprint-command changes.
When the contracts directory holds contracts from two different specIds, runSprintCommand executes only the contracts whose specId matches the latest spec.
When the latest spec has status needs-clarification, runSprintCommand refuses to run, prints a message naming the open clarifications, and invokes no generator.
When no contracts match the active spec, the error message instructs the user to re-plan or run the full pipeline.
The single-spec flow produces the same sprint selection as before and the full vitest suite passes.

nonGoals: Do not implement multi-spec parallel execution.
Do not change generator or evaluator behavior.
stopConditions: Stop when sprint runs only the active spec's contracts and refuses needs-clarification specs.
Stop when the single-spec flow is unchanged and all tests pass.
value.definitionOfDone: The sprint command scopes contract selection to the active spec, refuses to run a needs-clarification spec with a clear message, improves the empty-contracts message, and preserves the single-spec flow with all tests passing.
assumptions: loadLatestSpec (plan-state.ts:85) returns the spec whose contracts the user intends to run.
Filtering contracts by specId is safe because every materialized contract carries its specId.
outOfScope: Helper or plan-command changes (delivered in Sprints 1 and 2).
value.generatorNotes: In runSprintCommand (sprint.ts), after loadLatestSpec, filter listContracts to contracts where c.specId === spec.specId before findNextPendingSprint. Add a guard: if spec.status === 'needs-clarification', print the open clarification questions (reuse getOpenClarifications from contracts/spec.ts) and return without invoking the generator. Improve the existing 'No sprint contracts found' message (sprint.ts:115) to mention re-running plan or running the full pipeline. Keep the single-spec path identical when only one spec's contracts exist.
value.evaluatorNotes: Seed the contracts dir with two specs' contracts and assert only the latest spec's sprints run. Set the latest spec to needs-clarification and assert no generator invocation plus a clarifications message. Confirm the empty-contracts message references re-plan or run. Run the full suite to confirm no regression to the existing single-spec sprint behavior.
